translations.web: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.
translations.bsb: Jesus was teaching at the temple every day, but the chief priests, scribes, and leaders of the people were intent on killing Him.
translations.kjv: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,
